title: FBI-UAP-D017, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-2, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This document is a digital rendering and narrative statement created by the FBI in 2026 based on a 2023 sighting reported by a federal law enforcement agent.

incidents.summary: A federal law enforcement special agent reported observing a bright, circular yellow UAP over a two-day period near a sensitive national security site in the western United States.
incidents.quote: bright, circular yellow object, resembling a moon or an unidentified aerial phenomenon
